decisions.reason: A startup accelerator is far from the firm's machinery core and brings in no direct revenue, so a small firm with thin slack facing performance pressure would likely cut it during problemistic search.

The bio-based bitumen binder is a flagship with strategic and climate appeal, but it reaches into an unfamiliar materials market with uncertain results, so it is kept for now at substantial risk of being dropped if aspirations are not met.
The infectious waste plant is a flagship built in partnership with ERMAFA and close to the WASTX core, so shared resources and partner commitment justify carrying it despite early uncertainty.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant extends the core WASTX line with little extra resource demand and fits the decentralized strategy, so it is very likely to be retained.
